paginationReview.finding: A shared loading flag could block a newly navigated collection until a canceled old-page request completed, without scheduling another viewport check.
paginationReview.resolution: The loading owner is now the collection layout version. Only a request for that same version blocks another request, and an older completion cannot clear the new owner's flag.
paginationReview.loopGuards: Loading requires a visible loaded collection, valid viewport, available next page and no active error. A response that adds no items stalls automatic requests until collection reset.

limitations: This receipt records remote managed verification only. Any separately authorized Windows build, application launch or visual review is recorded by the integrating agent.
